nodes.label: graphify full extraction pipeline
nodes.rationale: Turns any folder of code/docs/papers/images/video into a persistent, queryable knowledge graph with an honest EXTRACTED/INFERRED/AMBIGUOUS audit trail, community detection, and query/path/explain tools, so codebase questions can be answered from a scoped subgraph instead of raw grep/full-file reads.

nodes.label: graphify fast-path query (existing graph.json)
nodes.rationale: If graphify-out/graph.json already exists and the user asks a natural-language question, skip the full rebuild (Steps 1-5) and jump straight to `graphify query` — avoids re-detecting/re-extracting the whole corpus just to answer a question.

nodes.label: Step 1 - detect/install graphify Python interpreter
nodes.rationale: Finds graphify via uv tool dir, pipx, or active venv (in that order) before falling back to install, and caches the resolved interpreter path in graphify-out/.graphify_python so every later step reuses the same environment that actually has graphify installed.

nodes.label: Step 3 - extract entities and relationships (AST + semantic)
nodes.rationale: Splits extraction into deterministic free AST parsing (Part A, code files) run in parallel with paid LLM semantic extraction (Part B, docs/papers/images) to save 5-15s on large corpora; Gemini backend used if GEMINI_API_KEY/GOOGLE_API_KEY set, otherwise Claude Code subagents do the semantic pass and no other provider API key is ever read.
nodes.norm_label: step 3 - extract entities and relationships (ast + semantic)

nodes.label: Part B - parallel semantic-extraction subagents
nodes.rationale: MANDATORY use of the Agent tool with subagent_type=general-purpose (never Explore, which is read-only and cannot Write chunk files to disk) dispatched all in one message so subagents genuinely run in parallel rather than sequentially; each subagent processes a 20-25 file chunk and writes its own chunk JSON to an absolute CHUNK_PATH.

nodes.label: graphify node ID normalization rule
nodes.rationale: IDs must be `{immediate_parent_dir}_{filename_stem}_{entity}`, lowercase, deterministic from label alone, with no chunk-number suffixes, so the same entity always yields the same ID regardless of which chunk processes it and so semantic-extraction IDs align with AST-extraction IDs (mismatched formats create orphan ghost-duplicate nodes).

nodes.label: graphify confidence_score rubric (EXTRACTED/INFERRED/AMBIGUOUS)
nodes.rationale: Discrete rubric (0.95/0.85/0.75/0.65/0.55, never 0.5) was chosen because production data showed models collapse a continuous 0-1 range into a bimodal distribution (>50% at 0.5, >40% at 0.85+) when given a free range instead of fixed anchor points.

nodes.label: graphify export neo4j / neo4j-push
nodes.rationale: Uses MERGE semantics so pushing to a running Neo4j instance is safe to re-run without creating duplicates.

nodes.label: graphify MCP stdio server (--mcp)
nodes.rationale: Exposes query_graph/get_node/get_neighbors/get_community/god_nodes/graph_stats/shortest_path as MCP tools so other agents/orchestrators can query the graph live instead of re-parsing graph.json.

nodes.label: graphify token-reduction benchmark
nodes.rationale: Only runs when corpus total_words > 5000, because for small corpora the graph's value is structural clarity rather than measurable token compression.

nodes.label: graphify add <url> ingestion
nodes.rationale: Auto-detects URL type (YouTube/video, Twitter/X oEmbed, arXiv, PDF, image, generic webpage-to-markdown) and, after a successful save, automatically runs the --update pipeline so the new file is merged into the existing graph without a manual second step.

nodes.label: graphify --watch background watcher
nodes.rationale: Debounces file activity (default 3s) so a wave of parallel agent writes triggers one rebuild instead of one per file; code-only changes rebuild immediately via AST with no LLM cost, while doc/paper/image changes only flag needs_update for a manual --update since they need LLM semantic re-extraction.

nodes.label: github-and-merge.md clone/merge flow
nodes.rationale: Running the skill pipeline separately per subfolder in a monorepo would clobber a shared graphify-out/ dir, so the CLI's `graphify extract <subfolder>` is used per service (writing graphify-out/ inside each scanned path) and the resulting graph.json files are merged at the project root with `graphify merge-graphs`.

nodes.label: hooks.md post-commit hook and CLAUDE.md integration
nodes.rationale: `graphify hook install` re-runs AST extraction only on files changed in the latest commit (doc/image changes ignored by the hook, need manual --update); `graphify claude install` writes the same always-on instructions into a project's CLAUDE.md so future sessions query the graph automatically without a manual /graphify invocation.
nodes.norm_label: hooks.md post-commit hook and claude.md integration

nodes.label: query.md BFS/DFS traversal, path, explain
nodes.rationale: BFS (default, depth 3) answers 'what is X connected to' broad-context questions; DFS (--dfs, depth-limited to 6) traces a specific chain/path; both fall back to inline NetworkX traversal of graph.json when the `graphify query` CLI is unavailable, and both save the Q&A back into the graph via `save-result` so future --update runs extract the answer as a node.

nodes.label: transcribe.md video/audio Whisper transcription
nodes.rationale: Writes a one-sentence Whisper initial_prompt itself from the corpus's existing god-node labels (no separate API call) to bias transcription toward domain vocabulary, falling back to a generic punctuation-only prompt when the corpus is video-only.

nodes.label: update.md incremental --update and --cluster-only
nodes.rationale: Detects whether all changed files are code-only and, if so, skips semantic subagent dispatch entirely (AST rebuild only, no LLM cost); uses build_merge() reading graph.json directly (not a NetworkX round-trip) specifically to preserve directed edge semantics for calls/implements/imports (issue #801), and preserves prior-run hyperedges via G.graph['hyperedges'] rather than overwriting them with only the new extraction's hyperedges.

nodes.label: UI/UX Pro Max design intelligence skill
nodes.rationale: Searchable database (67 styles, 96 palettes, 57 font pairings, 25 chart types, 13 stacks) with a priority-ordered rule taxonomy (accessibility/touch CRITICAL down to charts LOW) so design decisions are looked up rather than improvised; AGENTS.md rule 13.4 mandates this skill for all visual design work on palex-platform.
nodes.norm_label: ui/ux pro max design intelligence skill

nodes.label: --persist Master + page-overrides pattern
nodes.rationale: design-system/MASTER.md holds global rules; design-system/pages/<page>.md holds only deviations, checked first and falling back to MASTER when absent — avoids duplicating the whole design system per page.

nodes.label: escalar-incidencias.yml GitHub Actions cron
nodes.rationale: Fills the gap that Railway has no native cron: a GitHub Actions schedule (*/15 * * * *) calls /api/cron/escalar-incidencias with CRON_SECRET every 15 minutes and fails the workflow (::error + exit 1) on any HTTP status >= 400, giving visible CI alerting instead of a silently-broken escalation cron.
